correctness.rationale: Central symmetry reduces the Chebyshev-radius problem to centered facet distances. Orthogonal projection to the sum-zero hyperplane gives the exact facet-normal norm. Optimizing the two published complete-multipartite facet types yields the two closed-form obstructions, and the sole type-II admissibility edge case is dominated by type I. Exact enumeration through n=8 independently matches the formula in 42 multipartitions and 5868 facet labelings.
